title: alsinopsis douglasii
intro: Alsinopsis douglasii, commonly known as Douglas' alsinopsis, is a plant species in the family Primulaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
